# Public/client-safe configuration
NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL=http://localhost:3000
NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL=
NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY=
NEXT_PUBLIC_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY=
NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPPORT_EMAIL=

# Explicit local/E2E-only bypass. Never enable in production.
NEXT_PUBLIC_TURNSTILE_TEST_BYPASS=0
TURNSTILE_DEV_BYPASS=0

# Server-only secrets
SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY=
STRIPE_SECRET_KEY=
STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET=
AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY=
TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY=
RATE_LIMIT_HASH_SALT=
PROMO_FINGERPRINT_SECRET=
CRON_SECRET=

# Optional PulseAtlas portfolio observability; server-only and fail-open.
PULSEATLAS_ENDPOINT=
PULSEATLAS_WRITE_KEY=
PULSEATLAS_ENVIRONMENT=production

# Server-side Stripe catalog. Browser sends only starter/plus/pro pack IDs.
STRIPE_PRICE_STARTER=
STRIPE_PRICE_PLUS=
STRIPE_PRICE_PRO=

# Stripe TEST recurring monthly plans.
STRIPE_SUBSCRIPTION_PRICE_PLUS=
STRIPE_SUBSCRIPTION_PRICE_PRO=
STRIPE_SUBSCRIPTION_PRICE_STUDIO=

# Server-side admin bootstrap. Prefer an exact Supabase user UUID when already known.
# Otherwise configure a legitimate approved email; it becomes owner only after a
# verified Supabase sign-in. If ADMIN_OWNER_USER_ID is set, it is authoritative.
ADMIN_OWNER_USER_ID=
ADMIN_OWNER_EMAIL=

# Model and billing safety limits
TRANSFORM_MODEL=mistral/mistral-medium-3.5
WELCOME_CREDITS=0
BILLING_REQUESTS_PER_MINUTE=6
BILLING_CREDITS_PER_24H=50
BILLING_RESERVATION_TTL_MINUTES=10

# Best-effort application burst limits. Economic limits remain database-authoritative.
RATE_LIMIT_GUEST_PER_MINUTE=4
RATE_LIMIT_TRANSFORM_PER_MINUTE=8
RATE_LIMIT_TEXT_PER_MINUTE=8
RATE_LIMIT_FILE_PER_MINUTE=6
RATE_LIMIT_CHECKOUT_PER_MINUTE=4

-- Phase 9 developer API readiness hardening.
-- Require the concurrency-safe key creation contract as part of deployed readiness.

create or replace function public.developer_phase9_status()
returns jsonb
language sql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'ready',
      to_regclass('ops.developer_api_keys') is not null
      and to_regprocedure('public.developer_api_key_create(uuid,text,text,text)') is not null
      and to_regprocedure('public.developer_api_key_list(uuid)') is not null
      and to_regprocedure('public.developer_api_key_revoke(uuid,uuid)') is not null
      and to_regprocedure('public.developer_api_key_resolve(text)') is not null,
    'schemaVersion', '20260915032600',
    'hashedSecretsOnly', true,
    'verifiedAccountsOnly', true,
    'revocationSupported', true,
    'atomicKeyCap', true
  );
$$;

revoke all on function public.developer_phase9_status() from public, anon, authenticated;
grant execute on function public.developer_phase9_status() to service_role;

name: production-integrity

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  schedule:
    - cron: "17 */6 * * *"

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  verify-production:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    env:
      PRODUCTION_URL: https://provenance-cleaner.vercel.app
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: main
          fetch-depth: 1
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 24.x
      - name: Determine expected main SHA
        shell: bash
        run: echo "EXPECTED_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD)" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Verify canonical production matches main
        run: node scripts/verify-production.mjs --url "$PRODUCTION_URL" --expected-sha "$EXPECTED_SHA" --attempts 3 --delay-ms 5000
